children: Neptune Insurance Holdings appointed Cristian Melej to be its next chief financial officer, succeeding Jim Steiner.
Steiner plans to resign once the company files its annual report for the fiscal year ending Dec. 31, the company said in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Steiner will continue to serve as a board member, and as the chief operating officer of the subsidiary company Neptune Flood Incorporated.
Melej currently serves as CFO of Hingham Institution for Savings. He has served on Neptune's board since last year.
